problem_statement: NextJSTemplates startup-nextjs is a runnable Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind CSS 4 SaaS marketing template, dressed here as Loomwright, a workflow-automation studio for small operations teams. The marketing site has a single-page home (/) plus About (/about) and Contact (/contact) routes that share the Loomwright header, footer and theme toggler. The product team wants the pricing story to travel with the visitor across the whole marketing journey, so the layout gains a NEW shared 'Loomwright plan companion' rail that rides above the footer on the home, About and Contact routes: an on-brand indigo band with four tiles (Starter, Team, Scale, Fit guide) titled 'Loomwright plans at a glance'. In the pricing section (#pricing), the existing 'Find your Loomwright pricing fit' segment strip (Solo / Squad / Studio / Fleet) also gains a live 'Recommended fit' readout wired with React state exactly like the billing toggle. The work has four coupled requirements. (1) The companion rail's tile row must stay inside a 390px phone: the tiles wrap and shrink instead of sitting in a fixed non-wrapping row, so the home page has no horizontal scroll on mobile. (2) The rail must adopt the Loomwright indigo visual system (light indigo band, white cards, brand-blue accents, muted helper text) and must NOT drift into an off-brand palette. (3) The rail must render through the shared layout on the home, About and Contact routes so the same band appears across the marketing journey, not only on the home page. (4) Tapping a fit segment must update a terminal 'Recommended fit: <segment>' readout beneath the strip, keeping it in sync with the active segment. Preserve the Loomwright content, the billing toggle, the four Solo/Squad/Studio/Fleet segments, the three plan cards (Starter, Team, Scale), the section order and the visual system. (Note: the project is served as a Next.js static export over a static file server; the offline build infrastructure -- output:'export' with trailingSlash and unoptimized images, dropping the remote next/font/google import and Google Fonts @import, and rebranding the demo copy into Loomwright -- is supplied identically in all evaluation legs and is not part of the graded work.)
required_content: A shared 'Loomwright plan companion' rail renders through the app layout on the home, About and Contact routes (above the footer), titled 'Loomwright plans at a glance' with four tiles (Starter, Team, Scale, Fit guide), so the same band appears across multiple marketing routes rather than only on the home page.

The companion rail's tile row stays inside the viewport on a 390px phone: the tiles wrap and shrink instead of sitting in a fixed non-wrapping row, so the home page has no horizontal scroll on mobile.

The companion rail adopts the Loomwright indigo visual system (light indigo band, white cards, brand-blue accents, muted helper text) and does not recolor into an off-brand amber/teal or other off-palette band.

In the pricing section, tapping a fit segment (Solo / Squad / Studio / Fleet) updates a terminal 'Recommended fit: <segment>' readout beneath the strip and marks the active segment (aria-pressed), mirroring how the Monthly/Yearly billing toggle drives React state.

Preserve the Loomwright content, the four segments and their fit blurbs, the Monthly/Yearly billing toggle, and the three plan cards (Starter, Team, Scale); introduce no new console or network errors in any captured state.
design_constraints: Render the companion rail through the shared app layout (whitelisted on home/About/Contact); do not paste a separate copy per page or hang it off a single route.

Keep the rail in the Loomwright indigo language: a light indigo band background, white cards with thin indigo borders and a soft shadow, rounded 8px corners, brand-blue (#4a6cf7) accent color on the tile labels, uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow text, and small muted-gray helper text; no off-brand amber, teal, or high-contrast recolor of the band or cards.
The four-tile row must stay responsive and scannable and must not overflow the page horizontally on mobile; use fluid/wrapping tiles with consistent spacing rather than a fixed non-wrapping row.

Match the existing Loomwright typography and card style: the tile labels reuse the brand-blue button/accent treatment, headings keep the site's font weights, and the band spacing stays aligned to the container.

The fit segment strip must update both the active segment button (aria-pressed) and the terminal 'Recommended fit' readout together; the readout must not freeze on its initial value after interaction.
Keep the desktop and tablet layout and the section order intact; the companion rail is additive and subordinate to the existing sections.
state_constraints: The shared plan companion rail must render on the home, About and Contact routes and be captured as the main cross-page before/after evidence.
The companion rail's mobile tile row must be captured to confirm no horizontal page overflow.
The fit-segment interaction state must be captured after tapping a segment to confirm the 'Recommended fit' readout re-syncs.
About and Contact are cross-page anchors: the rail must appear there and must not be restyled off-brand to satisfy the task.
All rail and readout content must be inspectable as React/Next DOM, not flattened into screenshots or hidden offscreen.

change_completion: A shared plan companion rail is added through the app layout and appears on the home, About and Contact routes.
The rail carries the four tiles (Starter, Team, Scale, Fit guide) titled 'Loomwright plans at a glance'.
Tapping a fit segment re-syncs the terminal 'Recommended fit' readout to the active segment after interaction.
design_consistency: The rail uses the Loomwright indigo band, white cards, brand-blue accents, and muted helper text.
The rail keeps the native palette and does not recolor into an off-brand amber/teal band.
The rail reads as a refined marketing companion rather than a pasted off-brand section.
regression: The hero, feature grid, pricing cards, billing toggle, testimonials, blog teaser and contact block remain reachable and visually stable.
The existing theme toggle and responsive behavior are not broken by the rail.
responsive: Desktop lays the four companion tiles in a balanced band above the footer.
Mobile wraps or shrinks the tiles cleanly and avoids horizontal page overflow or text clipping.

author_notes: Repo-grounded startup-nextjs (NextJSTemplates) marketing restyle for Loomwright. The shared plan companion rail is rendered through the app layout across the home, About and Contact routes, reusing the Loomwright indigo design language and the repo's local logo/brand image assets, while the pricing-fit segment strip gains a live 'Recommended fit' readout. This task tests whether an agent can extend the marketing site with a consistent cross-page companion rail in the native visual system, keep it responsive and overflow-free, and wire the fit readout so it stays in sync, rather than appending an off-brand band or leaving a stale terminal state.
